findings.finding: The final bound assertion contains an extra closing parenthesis: book.admit_relation(*inp["attempt_pair"])). This prevents test-module parsing. Found by visual static review; no compilation was attempted.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Remove this single surplus parenthesis in the consolidated repair, before any shared worker import.

findings.finding: registry(path=None) forwards None to actual ObjectGraph, whose constructor immediately calls Path(path). Most C01 tests call registry() and will fail before reaching their intended assertions.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Give every helper call an owned temporary directory/path with cleanup, or require/pass explicit per-test paths. Preserve real durable F10 usage rather than substituting a stub.

findings.finding: Both SharedBarEngine.asof calls pass bar_id positionally. The real F09 API is keyword-only: asof(*,bar_id,cut,final_only=False).
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Use bar_id= at both calls and retain actual old/intermediate/new source and F10 queries; no hardcoded reference time switch.

findings.finding: Shared M12-IR-001 applies: all fields become partial on incomplete coverage, losing independently authenticated prefix open or suffix close. There is also an exact frozen-vector wording tension: CL-T03 expected_literal.field_support assigns partial to all four fields for missing opening coverage, while frozen M12-02 requires independently certified suffix close. Current C01 test compares this mapping directly to neutral field_support.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Root must retain and explicitly resolve the distinction between whole-window fidelity status and independent endpoint capability before repair. Implement authentic endpoint prefix/suffix checks with order/history/finality safeguards; keep H/L incomplete. Preserve all golden bytes and hand prices; do not silently rewrite either frozen expected payload.

findings.finding: Shared M12-IR-002 applies to L01 LocationSet plus C01 RangeVersion: both public dataclass results can be replaced with arbitrary geometry while retaining an authentic primitive. range_object_member and writer check source/field bindings, not the numeric formula recipe. Direct caller-created DerivedRangeMember objects/relations also bypass a consumer-only receipt check.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Use the root-reviewed factory receipt/recomputation design for complete result and wrapped-member recipes. Validate exact object and anchor-relation outputs, primitive/links, generator definition, formula role/ratios/geometry, clocks/horizon and required fields before mutation. Include forged C01 RangeVersion and direct wrapper variants in existing forgery/atomicity cases.

findings.finding: Shared M12-IR-009 applies: LocationSet horizon is not bound to actual graph TTL. C01 test registry has no TTL, and test_cl_l04 currently expects one active object exactly at its horizon5. The source record should remain retained, but eligibility must expire at the declared boundary. internal_locations also does not itself check raw lifetime/horizon the way shared reference require_primitive does.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Use existing F10 born_at+RegistryDefinition.ttl_ns with root-approved initial/corrected horizon checks; authenticate prior ObjectView.born_at and retain original horizon through revisions. Give fixture graphs matching explicit TTL and change horizon-boundary assertion to unavailable active set while retaining exact old get_version/target. Validate raw lifetime at derivation and horizon.

findings.finding: Shared M12-IR-003 affects C01 integration: tests call default prior_RTH semantics without actual predecessor attestation. E01 current/prior Formation helpers both declare the same synthetic trading date, despite the prior label. Capability tests are field diagnostics and should not imply a calendar predecessor.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: For true E0/prior cases construct actual explicit Calendar current/prior rows and use authenticated shared M12 selection. Use a truthful non-prior diagnostic semantic for field-capability-only cases. Keep numerical source values and exact13 identity denominator unchanged.

findings.finding: Shared M12-IR-004 extends to C01: range_version defaults known_at to primitive source-bar publication and can accept a prior scale only available at a later supplied cut while still returning the old known_at. A later selected named graph/calendar can likewise be present in the primitive while C01 range availability reports only bar publication. Common writer guards selected_at at its input cut, but standalone C01 relation/version availability understates dependencies.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Bind effective availability to the exact selected clock/graph/session and available prior-scale recipe, including the supplied causal derivation cut; validate all at the consumer decision/input cuts. Keep original F09 source publication time distinct. Add an existing cut/future-input negative assertion.

findings.finding: The writer reconstructs current trade summary/correction IDs, but does not reject a selected older F09 publication when a newer available same-stream publication changes coverage/watermark while retaining identical trade summary. An initial registry publication of the old complete source could activate despite the current retained source version being incomplete. Contiguous previous receipt checks do not cover an initial old version.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Check the actual latest available F09 publication for the same bar stream at the frozen decision cut as well as current admissions/corrections. Reject coverage/watermark rollback and missing known correction publications. Use a real bounded public lookup and expose any scan/reconstruction cost; historical exact queries must remain valid at original cuts.

findings.finding: The code requires BarDomain.measurement == BarDomain.aggregation_unit. F09 treats them as separate explicit semantic fields, and the registered contract did not freeze equality as a valid whole-trade criterion. This can reject a legitimate certified raw trade domain merely because its two labels differ.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Validate actual whole-Trade/time/raw-instrument and registered measurement-domain compatibility explicitly. Remove accidental label equality, or have root freeze a specific supported-domain declaration rather than infer semantic equality from strings.

findings.finding: The index lookup is bounded and visits one entry, but window_publication_source_identities_hashed increments len(event_ids) although bar.version_id and digest(retained_history_record) both hash that source payload; projection/predecessor validation repeats additional per-publication work. The test also silently records an empty registry metric because F10 exposes graph.stats, not graph.work.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Rename/count work to match actual operations/source items and retain total shared F09 capture/reconstruction costs separately. Wire actual graph.stats without a silent empty fallback. Preserve one-entry lookup assertions and clearly distinguish O(1) index access from O(single-publication payload) integrity hashing; no latency claim before execution.

findings.finding: The three finite-bound tests exercise a separate C01 metadata book, but range_version/range_object_member/publish_range_batch do not require or consume its admission decisions. Thus standalone metadata capacity checks do not enforce the declared whole range pipeline bounds. RangeDefinition.exact_ratio_tuple also has no independent finite length bound.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Bind an explicit immutable admission/retention policy or authenticated reservation to the registered production range publication path, with atomic no-mutation rejection. Alternatively narrow the admitted scope explicitly to the metadata component and leave pipeline capacity unpassed. Ensure declared ratio/input cardinalities are bounded; do not call the current isolated checks global capacity proof.

findings.finding: Coverage union processing depends on input order: a later span encountered before an earlier connecting span is not revisited, so permuting the same complete coverage can change observed_no_contact to censored. No canonical ordering requirement is validated.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Canonicalize or explicitly reject unordered/overlapping coverage before classification, then assert invariant results for an admissible partition/permutation in CL-E02. Keep full same-time competing-barrier labels in actual V01 scope rather than treating this helper as that model.

findings.finding: The validator compares three semantic/disposition strings and closure_granted but does not validate whole_source_closed or retained original proof/version fields. The current generated map preserves them, but a mutated proof or contradictory whole_source_closed=True can pass this function.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Validate both closure fields and the exact retained source identity/proof/definition snapshot supplied by the required map, with source-specific named assertion disposition rules. Add these mutations to the existing map-integrity vector; preserve the full237 denominator and genuinely empty assertion lists for uncovered models.

findings.finding: All41 named methods are present, but shared negative/invariance coverage is incomplete before acceptance: there is no explicit known-coverage rollback case, direct forged member/RangeVersion case, no-skipped-correction receipt case, or future clock-selection availability case. The current chunk/prefix exercise mostly reuses one source admission ordering; it does not compare multiple admissible chunk boundaries through the common writer.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Within the existing registered forgery/restart/frozen-cut cases, add the precise static-finding counterexamples and admissible chunk/prefix comparisons after the root-approved common recipe/expiry/availability fixes. Do not expand to unregistered source models, market data or learned/economic runs.
